notes.title: The IdeaBookRoom · OverWorld Island officially Release on August 18th!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, this is the developer of "The IdeaBookRoom" and "The IdeaBookRoom · OverWorld Island". The software offers Steam desktop and Android mobile versions.[/p][h2]The IdeaBookRoom[/h2][p]The IdeaBookRoom "is a writing and reading platform that supports multiple reading modes. During the reading process, you can see.[/p][p]Currently supports both online and offline novels.[/p][p]Online novels can set book prices, but currently only allow users to recharge. After purchasing a book, the author's account will increase coins, but it cannot be monetized for the author. The current function of the coin is only to purchase items in the game store.[/p][p]Offline novels can be exported and imported as. shu format data packages, and can also be shared in creative workshops.[/p][h2]The IdeaBookRoom · OverWorld Island[/h2][p]The IdeaBookRoom: OverWorld Island "is a game within the bookstore. For more information, please search for The IdeaBookRoom on Bilibili.[/p][p]This is a small world about genes, pets, exploration, and adventure, which is currently in its very early stages: the framework has been set up, but the plot, pet skeletons, skills, and props are still scarce.[/p][p]But——[/p][p]It will be permanently free![/p][p]It will be updated for a long time![/p][p]It will open a creative workshop![/p][p]That is to say, what you can play now is just a 'seed', a world that will slowly sprout over time.[/p][p]Next, we will gradually update the pets, plot, and gameplay to enrich this OverWorld Island.[/p][h2]Recent update plan:[/h2][list][*][p]Add more pet skeletons[/p][/*][*][p]New collection/combat events[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock the storyline and blessing system[/p][/*][*][p]Basic Skills&Prop Expansion[/p][/*][*][p]Animation&Special Effects: Grass leaves dancing, tree cutting sound effects, and busy pet movements make exploration more realistic.[/p][/*][*][p]Pet Egg Hatching: Eggs will have exclusive hatching animations, and during exploration, they may also be given "blessings" to make future pets stronger![/p][/*][*][p]Plot trigger: For example, the hatching of dragon eggs may open up a brand new "Dragon Island" storyline.[/p][/*][*][p]……[/p][/*][/list][h2]Request Support[/h2][p]If you like it, please add this free software 'The IdeaBookRoom' to your game library.[/p][p]You can also click the 'Recharge' button in the game to recharge coins for your account (coins can be used for reading).[/p][p]Support is not necessary, but it will become my motivation to keep updating.[/p][p][/p][p][b]This is still a small software and game, but it will grow step by step.[/b][/p][p][b]I hope everyone can try more, give more opinions, and even criticize, which is better than silence.[/b][/p][p][b]The IdeaBookRoom and the game OverWorld Island in the IdeaBookRoom will be officially released on August 18th. Stay tuned![/b][/p]
